{{Quote|Recently disclosed documents and testimony from a captured Thalassian slaver on Gyndine have implicated four Outer Rim Senators as profiting from slaving ventures in their sectors.|The [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reporting on Senator Ledwellow's involvement with slavers|<ref name="HoloNet1" />}}
'''Danry Ledwellow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented his homeworld and the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Ledwellow, a fradulent politician, allowed a [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slaver organization]]&mdash;illegal in the Republic&mdash;to operate in the Noonian [[Sector/Legends|sector]] while the he received kickbacks from the Thalssians. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Republic officials discovered&mdash;along with fellow Senators [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Bufus Ritsomas]], and [[Wuja Wojaine]]&mdash;that Wojaine was collaborating with the [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], resulting in all four senators being arrested on corruption charges, as well as having their positions censured.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Senator Tikkes (Mon Calamari), Senator Bufus Ritsomas (Till Chorios), Senator Danry Ledwellow (Er'kit) and Senator Wuja Wojaine (Pydyr) were all implicated.|The HoloNet News|<ref name="HoloNet1" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> Danry Ledwellow was the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'Kit/Legends|Er'Kit]] and the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], representing the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="HoloNet1" /> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], when a variety of worlds and corporations began to secede from the Republic in mass.<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Ledwellow was a corrupt individual, and during his career in the Senate, the politician struck a deal with the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]], one of the bloodiest and richest [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] organizations in the Outer Rim. Ledwellow would allow the Thalassians to operate in the Noonian Sector&mdash;illegal under Republic laws&mdash;while the Senator received kickbacks from the slavers for turning a blind-eye to their activities.<ref name="HoloNet1" />

However, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Republic officials discovered that Ledwellow was participating in the slavery ring after a Thalassian captured on [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] agreed to testify against the Senator. Ledwellow&mdash;along with fellow Senators [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Wuja Wojaine]], and [[Bufus Ritsomas]], who were also working with the Thalassians unbeknownst to Ledwellow&mdash;was arrested by Republic officials. Ledwellow and the other Senators caught up in the investigation had their seats in the Senate suspended and were detained at their respective embassies on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="HoloNet1" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a week before Ledwellow's scheduled arraignment, Senator Tikkes escaped from the [[Mon Calamari Embassy]], causing security at the [[Er'Kit Embassy]] to be increased to discourage Ledwellow from attempting to escape himself.<ref name="HoloNet2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}}</ref> The Thalassian slavers scandal and Ledwellow's part in it were later reported on by the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] in a pair of articles.<ref name="HoloNet1" /><ref name="HoloNet2" />

==Personality and traits==
Danry Ledwellow was a crooked and dishonest politician who was willing to allow a highly illegal and dangerous slaving trade to conduct business in his home sector in exchange for bribe money. However, this ultimately led to Ledwellow's downfall, as he was later arrested for his crimes.<ref name="HoloNet1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Danry Ledwellow first appeared in the [[in-universe]] ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50]]'' article ''Senators Implicated in Slave Ring''<ref name="HoloNet1" /> and later appeared in the ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51]]'' article ''Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail''.<ref name="HoloNet2" /> Senator Ledwellow was later given his own entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
